stored_text.note: None of the four files holds the framework itself. official.html, official-rendered.html and official-print.pdf are the TC260 announcement of 2026-09-14 (one sentence plus an attachment link); official-print.pdf is a one-page print of that announcement, not the framework PDF. secondary.html is the CAC release notice of 14 Sept 2026, three paragraphs in Chinese, with a link to the framework PDF (//www.cac.gov.cn/rootimages/uploadimg/1791137114683961/1791137114683961.pdf) that was not stored. verification.note says the framework PDF and its table of contents were read, but that PDF is not in local_copy. Title, issuer, release event, drafting bodies and the general structure can be checked; the summary's specific content claims cannot.

english_version.note: No English text in the stored files. Two web searches (English and Chinese) found no English version of Framework 3.0 from TC260 or CAC, only English commentary. The framework PDF linked from the CAC notice was not stored; whether it contains an English part (as one source reported for version 2.0) is unknown.

title.source_quote: 《人工智能安全治理框架3.0》发布
title.why: Word-for-word rendering; original_title matches the stored title inside the book-title marks character for character. The English form follows the title used for earlier versions; no official English title for 3.0 was found.

summary_claims.claim: keeps the structure of risk classification, technical countermeasures and comprehensive governance, and updates the risk taxonomy (inherent, application and derivative risks) and safety guidelines
summary_claims.original_quote: 延续“风险分类、技术应对、综合治理”的核心逻辑，与时俱进梳理更新了风险分类，优化调整了技术应对和综合治理措施
summary_claims.literal_translation: continues the core logic of 'risk classification, technical response, comprehensive governance', sorts out and updates the risk classification in step with the times, and optimises and adjusts the technical response and comprehensive governance measures

summary_claims.claim: New appendices cover risk-grading principles (the top tier has catastrophic and systemic features), an agentic AI risk management framework, and trustworthy-AI principles
summary_claims.locator: not present in any stored file

summary_claims.claim: It explicitly addresses loss of human control and unintended behaviours such as evading shutdown, and commits to building consensus guidelines on catastrophic AI risks
summary_claims.locator: not present in any stored file

key_terms.original: 风险分类、技术应对、综合治理
key_terms.register_rendering: risk classification, technical countermeasures and comprehensive governance
key_terms.note: 技术应对 is literally 'technical response'; 'technical countermeasures' is the usual rendering of this framework's section.

key_terms.original: 人工智能安全治理框架
key_terms.note: 安全 rendered as 'safety', in line with the English title of earlier versions; no stored English version to confirm.
The notes' 'CAC Data and Technology Support Center' renders 国家互联网信息办公室数据与技术保障中心 accurately.

issues: The framework PDF is not stored (official-print.pdf is a print of the announcement page), so the summary's most specific claims (inherent/application/derivative risks, appendices on risk grading, agentic AI and trustworthy AI, top tier with catastrophic and systemic features, loss of control, shutdown evasion, consensus guidelines on catastrophic risk) cannot be checked; none of 失控, 灾难, 智能体 or 附录 occurs in the stored files.
verification.note relies on the framework PDF's table of contents, which is not in local_copy.
note: What the stored notices do confirm: release on 14 Sept 2026 at the opening ceremony of the 2026 National Cybersecurity Publicity Week; TC260 as issuer under CAC guidance; drafting with the China Academy of Cyberspace Studies and the CAC Data and Technology Support Center; the retained classification / technical response / comprehensive governance structure. The CAC notice says versions 1.0 and 2.0 were issued in 2024 and 2025 but does not say 3.0 replaces 2.0 (the replacement is an inference). The same-week TC260 practice guides in notes appear on the TC260 home page stored as archive/CN-13/2026-10-11/secondary.html, not in CN-17's files.
